answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the meadow scores zero and the identity stops earning. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the spiral of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The mirror ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal ke3fc.
